source-authorized and explicitly validated BIF UTC offset, interval midpoint alignment and native QC0 analogues
distinct CDS-sourced ERA5-Land t2m, d2m, sp SHA-signed receipt, site coordinates and hourly UTC coverage
site-native independent cross-product temperature and water-vapor agreement with physically valid humidity
measured QC0 tower TA/VPD boundary anchors and VPD continuity for BOTH ends of EACH event
complete positive water vapor pressure, RH 0–100%, pressure and specific humidity after paired T/VPD edits
no other timestamps, 2005 Jan09 negative event, or earlier approved 2005 Jan06 10:00 repair changed
note: ERA5-Land is a distinct CDS-retrieved reanalysis product but is driven by ERA5; it is NOT independent meteorological ground truth. Separate download plus measured QC0 analogues required; physics-valid alone cannot approve.
outputs_if_and_only_if_all_gates_PASS: New isolated Stage13j shadow NOLEAP forcing, paired TA_USE/VPD_USE and recalculated TBOT/QBOT only at 67 exact native halfhours; time/surface/source immutability differential and SHA receipt.
on_gate_failure: No modification for rejected entire event; continue HOLD. Do not silently use ERA5-Land/companion ERA substitute, shift time, or modify model.
